question: A chemical compound X is prepared by heating gypsum. It is white powder and used as a fire proofing material. Compound X is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plaster of Paris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Plaster of Paris **(POP) is chemically known as **calcium sulfate hemihydrate (CaSO₄.1/2H₂O)**. 
 
• It is prepared by **heating gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O)** at approximately **150°C**, **which removes water and forms POP**.
 
• POP is a white powder that, when mixed with water, sets into a hard solid and is widely used in construction, mold-making, and art.
 
• One of its significant applications is as a **fireproofing material** because it resists heat and slows the spread of fire.
 
• It is also used for making casts for broken bones and as a decorative material in buildings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gypsum:**

 
 
• Gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) is a naturally occurring mineral primarily used to produce Plaster of Paris.
 
• It is also used in the manufacture of cement and fertilizer.
 
 
 
• **Setting Process of POP:**
 
 
• When mixed with water, POP undergoes hydration, forming a hard solid as it reverts to gypsum.
 
• This process is called **setting** and is exothermic in nature.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• POP is widely used in construction for making false ceilings, wall decorations, and molds.
 
• Its quick-setting property makes it suitable for emergency repairs and medical applications like orthopedic casts.
 
 
 
• **Fireproofing Material:**
 
 
• POP is an effective fireproofing material because it does not catch fire and provides thermal insulation.
 
• It is often used as a protective layer in buildings to slow the spread of fire.
